instr: Boxes: keep your eyes on the centre and press left or right as soon as a dot appears in a box.
clue: Keep your eyes on the cross in the middle. An arrow will appear there, then a dot in the left or right box. Press the left or right arrow key (or button) for the side where the dot appeared, as fast as you can. The arrow is usually right, but not always. Press Start when ready.
stage_label: Two boxes with a cross between them
